Two more items for this card, from PR #29784 (#29705):
- **en `engine.studio.auto.off` / `offTitle`.** These still read "Off" and "Disabled — will not run". The landing already says "switched off", and zh already reads 已停用. #29705 reverted its en change because of the gate below. Move them to "Switched off" and "Switched off — will not run" here.
- **The gate.** `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (~L185, `ISSUE_PATTERN = /^objectui#\d+$/`) refuses a designer waiver whose `issue` is an `objectstack#N`. The ui tree moved into this repo, so a new waiver cannot name a live card. An en-only change whose zh row is already right, as here, needs a waiver, so this card hits that gate.
  - Either widen the pattern to accept `objectstack#N` (a gate-script change: name it in the claim), or change the zh row in the same PR so no waiver is needed.
  - Note that `dispatch-gates` does not derive `check-i18n-en-drift`, so a local sweep misses it. It runs in CI's Type Check UI.
- **The matrix's hard-coded `OWD ` row-chip prefix** in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, which the #29705 dev also reported.
